# CyberUI 2045

> A cyberpunk-themed React UI library with neon-styled components and futuristic aesthetics.

## Summary
CyberUI 2045 is a React component library built with Tailwind CSS v4. It provides a set of pre-styled, responsive, and accessible components designed for "Cyberpunk" or "Sci-Fi" interfaces. Key features include neon glows, glassmorphism, and CRT effects.

## Documentation
- **Agent Guide**: [AGENT.md](https://github.com/patrickkuei/CyberUI/blob/main/AGENT.md) - Best practices for AI agents.
- **Storybook**: [Live Demo](https://patrickkuei.github.io/CyberUI/storybook) - Interactive component explorer.
- **Repository**: [GitHub](https://github.com/patrickkuei/CyberUI) - Source code and issues.

## Installation
```bash
npm install cyberui-2045
```

<!-- cyberui-2045:manifest:start -->
## Components (33)
- Forms: `Button`, `Input`, `Toggle`, `Select`, `Checkbox`, `FormField`, `RadioGroup`, `Slider`, `Combobox`, `DatePicker`
- Layout: `Card`, `Modal`, `Divider`, `Accordion`, `Drawer`
- Feedback: `Notification`, `Badge`, `Skeleton`, `Tooltip`
- Progress: `CircularProgress`, `SegmentedProgress`, `LinearProgress`
- Navigation: `TabNavigation`, `Carousel`, `Steps`, `DropdownMenu`, `Pagination`
- Typography: `GradientText`, `SectionTitle`
- Display: `Timeline`, `Table`
- Media: `Image`, `Avatar`

## Hooks & Context
- `useCyberScrollbar`: applies cyberpunk scrollbar styling to a scrollable ref.
- `useCyberNotifications`: `showNotification(type, title, message, options?)` toast trigger; requires `CyberNotificationProvider`.
- `useAnimatedProgress`: oscillating value generator for pulse/loading animations.
- `usePrefersReducedMotion`: `true` while the user prefers reduced motion; use it to gate inline-style animations that CSS cannot reach.
- `CyberNotificationProvider`: wraps the app once to enable `useCyberNotifications`.
<!-- cyberui-2045:manifest:end -->

## AI Coding Assistant Setup
Run once after install to inject a full usage guide (props, gotchas, theming tokens) into your AI config file:
```bash
npx cyberui-2045 init
```
Each tool gets the guide in its own file by default: Claude Code (`--claude`: `.claude/cyberui.md`, imported from `CLAUDE.md` with one `@.claude/cyberui.md` line), Gemini CLI (`--gemini`: `.gemini/cyberui.md`, imported from `GEMINI.md` with `@./.gemini/cyberui.md`), Cursor (`--cursor`: `.cursor/rules/cyberui.mdc`, always applied), GitHub Copilot (`--copilot`: `.github/instructions/cyberui.instructions.md`, for TS/JS/CSS files), and the open `AGENTS.md` standard (`--agents`: always pasted into `AGENTS.md`). `--all` does all five; `--inline` pastes the guide into `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `.cursorrules` or `.github/copilot-instructions.md` instead; `--dry-run` previews. Commit the generated guide file — if its folder is gitignored, teammates and CI get a dangling import or no guide. Idempotent — safe to re-run after upgrades, and it migrates a guide an older version pasted in.

## Usage Example
```tsx
import { Button, Card } from "cyberui-2045";
import "cyberui-2045/styles.css";

export const App = () => (
  <Card>
    <h1>Welcome to 2045</h1>
    <Button variant="primary">ENTER SYSTEM</Button>
  </Card>
);
```
